title: Candidate setup boundaries + HMM regime explainability

roska4_stress.proof: entry_conditions compares four basket COUNTS and an average gap against StressParams; no single price is the trigger, so a price line before setup would be invented

global_nkd.proof: detect_entry_for_slot returns SwingSetup(entry, stop) when a bar signals and None otherwise; the entry comes from a per-bar signal function, not from a standing level

roska4_swing.proof: same detector as global_nkd at a different ema_period

roska4_calm.proof: DECIDE and OBSERVE know different things; the 10:00 reference and planned stop are OBSERVE-only and must not appear at DECIDE

stress_setup_boundary_20260827.why_nearest_not_first: an operator asks how close the day came; the order the rules are declared in is an accident rather than an answer, so failures are ranked by distance relative to their own threshold
stress_setup_boundary_20260827.summary: No setup - Instruments gapped down 3 more needed

regime_explain.features_named_at_source: raits/hmm/features.py build_feature_matrix returns exactly two columns
regime_explain.the_real_answer: realised volatility is at the FLOOR of its 60-day range and sits nearest the Calm state's own mean; the day's return does not discriminate at all

lean_is_modest_by_design.definition: distance from the value to each state's mean, in that state's own standard deviations
lean_is_modest_by_design.mixed_when: best and second-best are closer than half a standard deviation
lean_is_modest_by_design.why: the three state means for log_return sit within a thousandth of each other; naming a lean there would be inventing attribution
lean_is_modest_by_design.not_an_attribution: a Gaussian HMM decodes a path over a joint distribution and does not decompose into per-feature contributions

regime_explain.no_fake_threshold: Viterbi compares states against one another and never against a cut; the page says 'No fixed shift threshold; the model chooses the most likely state' and offers the lead over the runner-up and the entropy in its place

performance.regression_i_caused: Stage 5ZZP called daily_slices on EVERY request
performance.why_not_a_ttl: a TTL hands back a stale answer as a fresh one for the length of the timer, which is the failure this route keeps finding in other clothes; an mtime key invalidates the moment a store is appended

the_62s_misattribution.first_reading: cold 95s, which read as the new work making it worse
the_62s_misattribution.measured_properly: the FIRST request to a freshly started backend costs ~62s whichever endpoint it is - a cheap reader took 62.63s in that position, and the market view took 11.0s once that cost had been paid by something else
the_62s_misattribution.conclusion: the number belongs to backend startup, not to this route - pre-existing and untouched by this stage, recorded as a named finding rather than folded into a figure that would have made this stage look responsible
the_62s_misattribution.page_survives_it: the market-view fetch is independent, so every other panel renders while it waits

market_view: setup-conditions row under the chart, one card per condition with value, threshold and distance when it fails
only the NEAREST failure emphasised - colour alone would make four cards shout at once
a sleeve whose entry forms only after a bar signals says so in a sentence instead of showing empty cards
regime: the full posterior as bars with uncertainty in bits
a Why this label table: input, value, 60-day percentile with z-score, and the lean
no lean where none can be claimed, with the reason on hover

intentionally_not_exposed.why: the setup is counts and an average, not a price
the entry comes from a per-bar signal function; publishing a distance would mean forming an entry the detector never formed
DECIDE must not show OBSERVE-only values; unwired rather than wired wrongly, unchanged from 5ZZP
a Gaussian HMM does not decompose; leans is a distance to a state mean and is named as such

highlights: metric values checked AGAINST THE DETECTOR'S OWN OUTPUT, not re-derived
entropy checked against its definition rather than against the implementation
the page is scanned for build_feature_matrix, predict_proba, Math.log, entry_conditions, peer_features and breadth_min, and every displayed number shown to be addressed out of the payload

defects_the_tests_caught.why_not_a_scroll_container: it would have hidden the overflow rather than removed it, and the row would still have been unreadable
defects_the_tests_caught.fix: below 560px each row is a block with the input name on its own line

defects_the_tests_caught.what: a case-sensitivity slip of mine, the THIRD time in these panels
defects_the_tests_caught.detail: an assertion pinned to `Why this label` against a heading the stylesheet uppercases
